t: TTB1329GRD 115mm corded angle grinder delivers consistent power for everyday cutting and grinding tasks. Ideal for metalworkers and DIYers working on workshop or site applications. Tool-free guard adjustment allows quick setup changes, whilst a 2-position side handle improves control during operation. The spindle lock makes disc changes fast and straightforward, reducing downtime. Equipped with an all-metal gearbox for durability, and fan-cooled motor to prevent overheating during prolonged use. Supplied with auxiliary handle and guard.
